title: SDLC controls policy binding
description: The active policy that produced a tier: the tier table and the CAF-SDLC-002 escalation rules, projected from the same map and policy the engine tiers against. Emitted by `sdlc-controls binding --format json`.
x-stability: Major version 0 while the binary is 0.x. Fields may be added in any release, and additionalProperties is left open at every extension point so a pinned copy of this schema keeps validating newer documents; a consumer must ignore fields it does not recognise. Removing a field, renaming one, or narrowing what one means bumps the major to policy-binding/1. Closed sets that the algorithm itself fixes (the tier scale, the exit codes) stay closed. See docs/contract.md.

binding.description: The engine binding: the tiering algorithm and the evidence shape, e.g. git-native-baseline@1. Unaffected by --policy — the tier table below carries the policy instance.

tiers.description: Required controls per tier. Every tier T0..T3 is present: a missing entry is rejected at load time so it can never read as 'no controls required'.
tiers.x-note: Closed on purpose, unlike the extension points above: the tier scale is fixed at T0..T3 by the algorithm, so an unrecognised key here is a typo rather than a future field.

map_version.description: `version` of the component map this binding was projected from.

escalation.description: CAF-SDLC-002 rules that move a change off its base tier. A declared-topology approximation of blast radius, not a computed dependency graph.

unmatched_path_criticality.description: Fail-safe class the component map declares for a changed path that matches nothing.

unmatched_path_tier.description: Tier that criticality resolves to — the floor applied when unmatched paths are present.

shared_increment.description: Added once when any affected component is declared shared.

breadth_threshold.description: Affected-component count at which breadth_increment applies. 0 disables the rule.

map_change_self_escalates_to.description: Tier a change to the component map or tier policy itself takes.

cap.description: Ceiling every escalation is clamped to.
